objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless content object in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, instructions and related document records.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Corresponding type selected when creating a new document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document, adaptable to requirements and same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and is associated with versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata indicating the document status.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations through User Groups.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute for the registered author of the document.

attributes.name: co_authors
attributes.description: Attribute for additional persons with change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute for reviewers of the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute for releasers of the document.

attributes.name: translation
attributes.description: Attribute included with releaser assignment for translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity starts, calculated from release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity extension check is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Validity expiration date calculated from Valid From and Period of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute affecting email notification for assigned groups and persons when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute affecting distribution of acknowledgement workflow tasks when the next version is released.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version of a released document before translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which released translated document is visible to authorized readers.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specifies in which clients the document is visible or not.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed special work steps relevant for few departments.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification used to differentiate and structure documents and to define templates, validity and archive settings.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for common document types.

attributes.name: document_template
attributes.description: One or more templates that can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents remain before physical deletion.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system to create new documents or related information objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office formats used to generate new documents, such as Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment associated with a main document and released with the main document.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Content that has an effect on the associated version of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Attachments are subject to their own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Attachments pass through all statuses of the release process of the main document.

attributes.name: validity
attributes.description: Attachments have the same validity as the main document when released through validity extension.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Additional information object that supplements a document and is not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Released and published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Document attachment or relevant equipment/additional information mentioned as supplement to documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system user involved in authoring, reviewing, releasing, reading, translating or administering documents.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned directly to authorizations or distribution.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for role assignment, read authorization, distribution and archive access.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group, such as Reader - Document Management, Authors, Reviewer, releaser, Archive, or Business Admin group.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned to documents to provide read and change rights.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Group and person-related authorization assigned in document properties.

attributes.name: read_rights
attributes.description: Read access rights for documents and dependent objects.

attributes.name: change_rights
attributes.description: Change access rights for documents and dependent objects.

attributes.name: write_access
attributes.description: Access allowing users to create requests for AKS for selected documents.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role implemented in DHC VISION to provide users with functions according to area of application.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for a system role.

objs.name: document_author
objs.description: Role or user responsible for authoring documents.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role or user who can view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person with additional personal change rights on a document and no relevance within release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Person responsible for document and content and deciding distribution to readers.

objs.name: document_approver
objs.description: Role corresponding to releaser responsible for approving documents.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Person who can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: Person who creates a document, proposal or request and may be initiator of workflows.

objs.name: editor
objs.description: Person editing a workflow step or document content.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing an existing document without affecting document content or version history at creation.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing Change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Change proposal is completed or otherwise displayed/managed.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created for a selected document to invalidate or override it.

objs.name: request_for_out_of_force
objs.description: Request retained for documentation after declaration of Out of force.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate invalidated documents.

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Creator of the request for reactivation.

objs.name: workflow_participant
objs.description: User involved in workflow steps and completing tasks with electronic signature.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants or acknowledgement recipients.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow task.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Signature of an individual participant documented in the system and printable as document content.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Email sent by the system to inform users about workflow tasks, change proposals, validity extension, release or acknowledgements.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: Assignment of User Groups and persons to a document distribution list for read authorization, notification, acknowledgement and dashboards.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List per document containing User Groups and persons for distribution.

attributes.name: user_groups
attributes.description: User Groups assigned to the distribution list.

attributes.name: persons
attributes.description: Persons assigned to the distribution list.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status used in acknowledgement reports.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display populated by distribution groups and document relevance.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard listing all documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents and instructions.

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Parameters available for reports.

attributes.name: selection_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria available for reports.

attributes.name: evaluation_results
attributes.description: Results filtered according to settings made.

objs.name: status_report
objs.description: Report providing evaluations of documents or instructions depending on selected parameters.

objs.name: instruction
objs.description: Instruction stored in the system and evaluated by reports.

objs.name: traffic_light_system
objs.description: Status display for reports using green, yellow and red indicators.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released document content.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Release state of the translated or original language version.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system for which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process object that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit object that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk object that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data object that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master data object referenced by document properties.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained as document property.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained as document property.
